AgroStar · Helping Farmers Win  ·  May 2026
Launched May 2026
The Operating System (POS).
Built to run AgroStar's
Retail at scale.
AgroStar POS is built from the ground up to run our Company Owned stores — connecting orders, inventory, and finance into a single mobile-first experience.
Aim
Give every store manager a Digital Platform to run their entire store — stock, sales, payments, and reconciliation — without touching any other system.
At a Glance — 30 Seconds
→ We built AgroStar POS to scale operations across every Company Owned store — one platform, end-to-end, from stock receipt to financial settlement.
→ One screen replaces CRM + WMS + NAV-BC — all talking to each other in real time.
→ Live since May 15 · 88 orders · 77 farmers served · ₹1,07,379 Gross Sales · growing every week.

AgroStar POS — In Action
Inventory
Farmer Search
Orders
Magic Moment 01
New stock arrived.
Or needs to be raised. POS handles both.
When any new stock arrives at the store via Stock Transfer, the store manager opens POS on their phone. They tap through incoming inventory — batch by batch, good or damaged — and hit confirm. The warehouse system updates automatically. No calls. No email. No waiting.
📦  Raise stock requests — auto-converts to a warehouse transfer order
✅  Receive stock with good/bad capture per batch — WMS updates instantly
🔄  Mark damaged inventory — moves to the correct bin automatically
Track Incoming Transfers
Receive Stock Batch by Batch
Magic Moment 02
A farmer walks in.
Billed and out in
under 3 minutes.
The manager searches the farmer by mobile. Profile appears instantly. The farmer browses live prices, offers, real stock. Invoice sent to WhatsApp. Payment collected — cash or UPI. Ledger settled automatically.
🔍  Search farmer by mobile — or register instantly
🛒  Full catalog with live prices, offers, stock
🧾  Invoice pushed to NAV-BC — no manual entry
💳  Cash to store VAN — auto-reconciles to ledger
↩️  Returns on same screen — credit posted automatically
Magic Moment 03
An online DVS order just came in.
The store can handle it.
A farmer in the store's catchment placed an order on the AgroStar app. It routes directly to the nearest COCO store. The manager sees it in POS, marks it available and triggers the invoice in one tap.
📱  DVS orders appear directly in POS — accept, flag OOS, or process
🚚  Invoice generated — order picked up by the LMD partner
Under the Hood
POS is not a billing app. It is the connective layer between three systems that now work as one. When a sale happens on POS, all three know about it instantly and automatically.
